content.text: I've completed the research. Here is the plan.

input.summary: Add a public `radar.clockwise` boolean option (default `false`, preserving today's counter-clockwise indicator layout) to the radar coordinate system. When `true`, indicator axis angles must decrease with indicator index instead of increasing, so indicators progress clockwise on screen while label/name placement (which is driven off `IndicatorAxis.angle` via `AxisBuilder.rotation`) keeps working unchanged.
steps:
src/coord/radar/RadarModel.ts — declare the option on the public interface. In `export interface RadarOption extends ComponentOption, CircleLayoutOptionMixin {` (starts line 58), line 61 currently reads `    startAngle?: number`. Insert immediately after it (before line 63 `    shape?: 'polygon' | 'circle'`):
```ts
    startAngle?: number

    /**
     * Whether the indicators are laid out clockwise.
     * `false` (default) keeps the historical counter-clockwise order.
     */
    clockwise?: boolean
```
No other type file needs touching: `RadarOption` is already re-exported publicly via `src/export/option.ts:22` (`import type {RadarOption as RadarComponentOption} from '../coord/radar/RadarModel';`), and the root `/workspace/index.d.ts` only re-exports `./types/dist/echarts`.

src/coord/radar/RadarModel.ts — add the default. In `static defaultOption: RadarOption = {` (line 178), line 188 currently reads `        startAngle: 90,`. Insert right after it:
```ts
        startAngle: 90,

        clockwise: false,
```
Default MUST be `false`: today `coordToPoint` maps `(x, y) = (cx + coord*cos(angle), cy - coord*sin(angle))`, so increasing angle moves counter-clockwise on screen, and `resize()` currently increments the angle per indicator. Defaulting to `true` would flip every existing radar chart (and every `test/radar*.html` visual baseline).

src/coord/radar/Radar.ts line 20 — delete the stale marker comment `// TODO clockwise` (this feature is exactly what it tracks). Keep the blank line separation before `import IndicatorAxis from './IndicatorAxis';` on line 22.

No changes are needed anywhere else in the radar stack, but verify these consumers still behave: `Radar.coordToPoint` (src/coord/radar/Radar.ts:90-96) and `Radar.pointToData` (lines 98-123) are direction-agnostic (the latter picks the nearest axis by `Math.abs(radian - indicatorAxis.angle)`); `src/chart/radar/radarLayout.ts:37-58` iterates axes by index and closes the polygon, so reversed winding is harmless; `src/component/radar/RadarView.ts:_buildSplitLineAndArea` (lines 66-203) builds split-line/split-area polygons in axis-index order — reversed winding still fills correctly for these convex rings; `src/chart/radar/RadarView.ts` never touches angles (only `polar.cx/cy` at line 109).

Add a unit test at `/workspace/test/ut/spec/coord/radar.test.ts` (the `coord` directory does not exist yet; `test/ut/jest.config.cjs` already matches `'**/spec/coord/**/*.test.ts'`, so no config change is required). Follow the existing style: ASF license header, then `import { createChart, removeChart, getECModel } from '../../core/utHelper';` (see `/workspace/test/ut/spec/api/converter.test.ts:1-25`). Build a chart with `radar: { indicator: [...4 items...], startAngle: 90, center: ['50%','50%'], radius: 100 }` plus a `radar` series, then read `(getECModel(chart).getComponent('radar') as any).coordinateSystem.getIndicatorAxes()` and assert: (a) default — angles are `PI/2, PI, -PI/2, 0` for 4 indicators (counter-clockwise, increasing); (b) `clockwise: true` — angles are `PI/2, 0, -PI/2, PI` (decreasing/clockwise); (c) index 0 stays at `startAngle` in both modes; optionally assert `coordSys.dataToPoint(max, 1)` x-coordinate flips sign between the two modes. Use a small epsilon comparison (the existing converter spec uses `DELTA = 1E-3`).

Optional but recommended manual/visual coverage: add a `clockwise: true` radar block to `/workspace/test/radar.html` (or a new `test/radar-clockwise.html`) alongside a default-direction chart so the two orderings can be compared. Do NOT change `startAngle: 90` in `/workspace/test/radar4.html:62` or any existing radar test option — those feed the screenshot baselines listed in `/workspace/test/runTest/actions/__meta__.json:180-183`.
input.risks: Main ambiguity is the default value. Current behavior is counter-clockwise (proved by `coordToPoint`: `y = cy - coord*sin(angle)` combined with `angle = startAngle + idx*2PI/n`), and the requirement wording ("domain conventions that expect the indicators to progress clockwise") frames clockwise as opt-in, so `clockwise: false` is the backward-compatible default. Note that `angleAxis.clockwise` in polar defaults to `true` (src/component/polar/install.ts:43), so a reviewer may argue for consistency — but flipping the radar default would change every existing radar chart and all `test/radar*.html` visual baselines, so it should not be done here. Secondary notes: (1) `Radar.pointToData` has a pre-existing wrap-around bug comparing raw radian differences near ±PI; it is direction-independent, do not try to fix it in this change; (2) `RadarModel.optionUpdated()` (lines 106-172) copies shared options into per-indicator models — `clockwise` is a coordinate-system-level option and must NOT be merged into `InnerIndicatorAxisOption`; (3) `AxisBuilder` receives `rotation: indicatorAxis.angle` with fixed `labelDirection: -1, tickDirection: -1, nameDirection: 1` (src/component/radar/RadarView.ts:49-56) — these stay as-is; the angle normalization is what keeps names/labels upright, so do not drop the `Math.atan2` line.
